messages:
IncidentBot: PAGER triggered: high 5xx rate on inference-serving-prod (incident id: INC-2026-314). Paging @Maya and eng-oncall.
Maya (oncall): saw it. Starting a short bridge, joining now. Can someone grab customer-impact numbers?
Zoe (support): customer dashboard — ~8% of requests returning model-error in last 12m, mostly chat/generate routes. Raising CS ticket for impacted customers.
Jordan (runtime): I see a sudden jump in memory-cache evictions and long tails on batch latency after the midnight quantized rollout. Repro: tail latency > 1s for some requests.
Priya (SRE): logs show increased retry loops from the worker pool (error 502 -> retry -> timeout). Probable pressure on the KV layer + batching amplify.
Maya (oncall): action: 1) mitigate immediately (rollback or fallback), 2) contain customer impact, 3) collect metrics for postmortem. Who can flip fallback?
Jordan (runtime): I can flip fallback to the fp16 baseline in place of the quantized variant. Will do now and monitor.
Jordan (runtime): /deploy rollback model-serving:quant-v3 -> baseline/fp16-v2
Jordan (runtime): rolled back. Metric check incoming.
Priya (SRE): running quick sanity queries: 
```
curl -s "https://metrics.internal/api/query?expr=rate(inference_errors[5m])" | jq .
kubectl get pods -l app=inference -o wide
```
Priya (SRE): after rollback, 5xx rate dropping from 7.9% -> 1.6% over 8m. Latency p95 back to ~120ms.
Zoe (support): updating affected customers: note that workaround is automatic rollback, we've alerted major accounts. No data exfil.
Maya (oncall): good containment. Starting a post-incident follow-up thread and scheduling a lightweight postmortem. Proposed time: tomorrow 10:00 PT. Who's available?
Jordan (runtime): I can attend. Will prepare perf diffs between quant-v3 and baseline.
Sanjay (infra): I'll pull GPU scheduler logs and eviction traces. Also will snapshot node metrics around midnight.
Priya (SRE): I'll collect alert timeline, retry traces, and the worker pool state. Assign me to write the initial draft.
Maya (oncall): temporary mitigation notes -> rolled back quantized variant; increased KV cache size by +15% as a short-term guard (manual change) — revert plan: after analysis.
Jordan (runtime): hypothesis: quantized variant changed attention kernel packing which increased memory churn for certain long-sequence requests; caching policy then thrashed and batching triggered retries.
Zoe (support): customers asked for timeline and short-term RCA. I'll add that rollback and cache-size bump reduced errors, will follow up with postmortem link.
Maya (oncall): Action items (owner / estimate):
- Collect perf diffs + RPC-level traces -> Jordan / EOD today
- GPU scheduler + node evictions snapshot -> Sanjay / EOD today
- Alert timeline & retries -> Priya / EOD today (initial draft of postmortem)
- Customer comms follow-up -> Zoe / +2 hours
- Re-run quantized variant on staging with focused long-seq load -> Jordan + Sanjay / tomorrow
- Add persistent autoscaling guard to prevent retry-amplify -> Priya / next sprint
Priya (SRE): creating PM ticket: PLATFORM-INC-314 with the above owners.
IncidentBot: Bridge call started by Maya at 2567890140. Bridge ended at 2567893600. Page acknowledged by Maya.
Jordan (runtime): quick note — I captured model kernel config and the quantization profile used in the rollout: quant-config-id qc-2026-03-16-9. Attaching to the ticket.
Maya (oncall): scheduling postmortem: 2026-03-18 10:00 PT. Priya to own writeup; Jordan to present perf analysis; Sanjay to present infra traces; Zoe to summarize customer impact.
Zoe (support): customer list: acct-omega, acct-lumen, acct-sky — outreach started. No escalations yet.
Priya (SRE): postmortem checklist draft: timeline, root cause hypotheses, data to confirm, mitigation record, action items + owners, rollback criteria for future rollouts, canary ramp checklist updates.
Jordan (runtime): propose an additional rollback criteria: p95 latency delta > 2x baseline OR cache-eviction rate > 10% over 5m during canary. Adding to ticket.
Maya (oncall): agreed. Priya add to checklist.
Sanjay (infra): follow-up: we should instrument per-model KV hit/miss metrics and early throttling when eviction > threshold. Creating infra ticket INF-2026-88.
Priya (SRE): updated PLATFORM-INC-314 with INF-2026-88 link.
Maya (oncall): closing this immediate thread. Last status: rollback completed, errors reduced, customers notified, postmortem scheduled. We'll track action items in PLATFORM-INC-314.
Zoe (support): thanks team. I'll post follow-up customer note after PM draft.
Jordan (runtime): will re-run quant tests on staging tomorrow and post results. Leaving detailed logs in ticket.
Priya (SRE): initial draft will be shared by 18:00 PT today for comments.
Maya (oncall): Thanks all. If anything else pops up, ping me or reopen the pager. :thumbsup:
